svg.title: A strip plot of the within-layer Fisher percentile of 311 poles, in two rows: the 252 that keep their explanation on the instruct model and the 59 that fail. The two rows spread over the same range, with similar medians. The AUC is 0.475, and the null mean is 0.523.
svg.text: A neuron's Fisher importance does not tell
Each mark is a VERIFIED pole of Qwen2.5-0.5B: its neuron's Fisher, as a percentile within its layer.
AUC 0.475 against a within-layer null of 0.523 (p = 0.21). The ticks are medians.
percentile of the neuron's Fisher within its layer
